---
name: Data source proposal
about: Suggest a source for review before ingestion
labels: data
---

## Source

Publisher and public landing-page URL (no signed links or credentials).

## Rights and access

Exact license/terms URL and access conditions. Public access alone is not a license.

## Coverage and usefulness

Geography, time period, species, schema/format, collection effort and limitations.
Explain which Corridor workflow the data could support.

## Privacy

Describe generalization or restrictions needed. Link public metadata; do not attach
raw observations, photos, animal IDs or sensitive coordinates.
